patthana15.78:1.1: saraṇaṃ dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.78:2.1: saraṇaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.78:3.1: araṇaṃ neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. saraṇaduka ācayagāmittike nasaraṇaduka naācayagāmittikaṃ
